Extracts heading hierarchy (h1-h6) from HTML page

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.status_code.inspect
puts result.metadata.headings[0].level.inspect
puts result.metadata.headings[0].text.inspect
puts result.metadata.headings.length.inspect
```
